President Murmu Hails Anti-Terror Operation, Calls Treaty Suspension Decisive

President Droupadi Murmu described 'Operation Sindoor' as a significant achievement in combating terrorism and stated that suspending the Indus Waters Treaty was a decisive step against terror-harboring nations. She made these remarks in an address, emphasizing the importance of these actions in national security. The President also highlighted the role of students as architects of India's future and backed exam reforms.
